Maya: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to Carlos and Priya for staying late to debug that latency spike during the demo tonight. You two calmed me down faster than coffee :heart:
Carlos: Aw thanks! Team effort. Priya found the weird quantization fallback in the config, that was the kicker.
Priya: Yep, spotted the bad flag in the model config. Happy it was just a toggle and not the runtime.
Devon: Big +1. Also appreciate Jen for grabbing the logs and trimming the noise so we could see the real signal. Saved us 30 mins.
Jen: Happy to help! If anyone wants brownies tomorrow, I’ll bring a batch to the kitchen :brownie:
Maya: Brownies = onboarding reward for late-night rescues. Legend status unlocked :trophy:
ops-bot: Incident #2026-19 marked resolved by Carlos, Priya. Duration: 18m. Tags: latency, demo.
Carlos: Also, shoutout to the infra team for the quick restart window. Smooth as butter.
Priya: Couldn’t have done it without the pinned debug snippets in #eng-runtime. Please keep adding those tiny notes — they pay off.
Devon: Can we add a short blurb to the post-demo notes so future demos don’t hit the same trap?
Maya: Done — adding a 1-line checklist to the demo runbook now and tagging everyone. Thanks again, y’all :sparkles:
